tags.description: Originally kerosene, no longer operating. The interior is a museum open to the public in season. Light room is accessible and still has the clockwork wind-up mechanism that rotated the light. Gift shop next door is sometimes open, picnic tables.
tags.name: Walton Harbour Lighthouse and Museum
